flagged.evidence: The Remark says “the finite sums over G are those of [[def-sum-over-a-finite-index-set]].” That dependency defines summands only for “a : S → R or a : S → N”; the sums here have complex-valued terms. It therefore does not license the Remark’s citation for these sums. The item’s statement and facts cite the generic commutative-monoid sum definition, but that does not make this Remark citation accurate.
The page calls Z/5Z “the smallest cyclic group of prime order.” Z/2Z is cyclic of prime order 2 and has smaller order, so the claim is false.
